summary:
## Standing operator rules
Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder. Never enable a new Celery task in ledgerly/tasks/ unless perf/locust_tasks.py demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures. Keep commits small so review stays easy. Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Fix nightly reconciliation double-counting refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The Tenacity refactor is superseded until next sprint.

## Ruled-out approaches
Wrapping webhook handlers in a five-attempt retry decorator resent customer emails multiple times. Tenacity refactoring was stopped until next sprint.

## Recent work
Removed `_last_batch` retention; worker and full suites pass, and memory now settles. Consolidated billing CLI filters and deduplicated currency options; 37 relevant tests pass. Ruff found two E501 lines in `ledgerly/cli.py`. Webhook v2 cutover advanced through service patching and creation of `webhook-replay-a`; next run `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a`.
